kitDescription: Rosanna: Chic Ocean is a Wind AR Supporter on Burst II whose kit is built around fighting bosses that have destructible parts. Two separate lines (one firing at the start of battle, one on her Skill-2 cooldown) each give the whole team Damage to Parts ▲24.26% for 15 seconds, and a third line hands every ally a stacking ATK boost worth 3% of her own ATK (up to five stacks, 30 seconds) each time anyone destroys an enemy part. Her only personal damage is a Skill-2 sustained damage-over-time on the enemy nearest her crosshair — 70.4% of her final ATK once per second for 15 seconds. Her burst is pure amplification: Sustained Damage ▲20.32% to all allies plus Damage Taken ▲32.23% on all enemies, both for 10 seconds, which together roughly double the value of her own tick and boost anything else on the team that deals sustained damage. Against the partless scope-lock boss the parts buffs and the part-destroy ATK stacks do nothing at all, so almost all of her real kit value is invisible in this basis and she correctly looks weak here.

redAssertions: S5 'ticks ~1/sec and is MAINTAINED across the fight' (expects 100–200 DoT ticks) — driver ships 75. CADENCE: blind assumed continuous self-tiling because the datamined skillCooldownsSec was withheld in blind mode; the S6 blind writer flagged this exact field as its #1 lever with the recipe 'read the datamined skillCooldownsSec and set sec to it', which resolves to the driver's 30. Ground truth (Section 3) + owner ruling 2026-07-20 back the driver. NOT a divergence.

S5 'the DoT is real damage on her own row, and inert on teammates' — teammate totals are not byte-identical when the DoT is deleted. Engine-correct: DoT ticks feed the burst gauge (game-mechanics §6, 'skill hits and DoT ticks generate the caster's flat target value'), so deleting 75 ticks perturbs the rotation. Blind modeling assumption, not a driver fault.

S5 'NON-VACUITY: she is Burst II and actually casts in this fixture' — FIXTURE DEGENERACY: controlComp puts crown (B2) alongside her, crown takes all 10 stage-2 casts, rosanna-chic-ocean casts 0 times. The blind writer's own canary text says a RED here is 'a FIXTURE diagnosis, not a kit-model finding'.
S5 'the boss debuff benefits the WHOLE team' — vacuous under the same 0-cast fixture.
S5 'Sustained Damage ▲20.32% lands on all allies at its raw percentage' — vacuous under the same 0-cast fixture.
S5 'is SUSTAINED-flavored — her own Sustained Damage ▲ moves it' — vacuous under the same 0-cast fixture (no sustainedDamagePct ever applies, so the 400× boost is a no-op).
S5 'duration is a 10-SECOND wall-clock window, not permanent' — vacuous under the same 0-cast fixture.

verdictRationale: GO. Mechanically the S5 blind suite runs RED against the driver's shipped override (7 passed / 7 failed / 1 skipped), and I traced all 15 assertions rather than accepting the driver's triage: the failure set is exactly {#7 cadence, #8 gauge-coupling, #9/#10/#12/#13/#15 burst-block}, and the pass/fail/skip arithmetic reconciles, so the driver's classification is verified, not taken on faith. Five of the seven are the blind fixture's own diagnosed degeneracy — controlComp seats crown (B2) beside a Burst-II unit, crown takes all ten stage-2 casts, rosanna-chic-ocean casts zero times, and the blind writer's own non-vacuity canary states in-file that a RED there indicts the fixture, not the model; the driver re-ran those same assertions in a fixture where she owns B2 and got GREEN. One (#8) asserts byte-identical teammate totals when the DoT is deleted, which is wrong on engine grounds the SSOT states plainly (DoT ticks feed the burst gauge, §6), so deleting 75 ticks must perturb the rotation. That leaves exactly ONE substantive divergence — the DoT cadence, 75 ticks (5×15s windows, 42% uptime) vs the blind pair's ~180-tick continuous self-tiling — and it resolves in the driver's favour on ground truth both blind agents were denied: datamined skillCooldownsSec.skill2 = 30 plus the owner's 2026-07-20 internal-cooldown ruling. Critically, the S6 blind writer flagged that exact field as 'the dominant magnitude lever on her whole output' and wrote the recipe ('read the datamined skillCooldownsSec and set sec to it'), which resolves to 30 — so the blind divergence is a converged flag, not a contradiction. Every other line is structurally identical across the driver, the S6 blind override, and the cross-family (claude-fable-5) S2b spec: 6/6 kit lines FAITHFUL or DOCUMENTED_GAP, faithfulness 1.0, no REAL-GOTCHA of any subkind. Discrimination is genuine — eight counterfactuals go RED (invented dur999 continuous → 179 ticks from t=1; lvl-9 67.2/19.4/30.76; fullBurstEnter re-key → 5 FB-start frames vs 9 cast frames; sustained and taken removals; parts removal byte-identical) — and every FAITHFUL block is shown to FIRE at its prose cadence (3 frame-0 parts applies, S2 parts at 30/60/90/120/150, 75 DoT ticks first at t=31, burst pair on all 9 cast frames), so nothing here is modeled-but-inactive. Two residuals for owner spot-check, neither blocking: (1) the S2 first-fire PHASE is still a ⚑ convention — t=CD vs t=0 is one full 15-tick window, ~20% of her DoT output, and only a popup-cadence read pins it; (2) the same-model residual is thinner than usual because S2b came from claude-fable-5, but S5, S6 and this judge are all claude-opus-5, so their agreement on the burstCast trigger identity and the 'sustained' flavor tag proves stability rather than correctness — the flavor tag in particular is load-bearing (it is the sole reason her burst amplifies anything) and is worth one owner glance. Her low output on this board is faithful, not a defect: both Damage-to-Parts lines and the part-destroy ATK stacks are structurally inert against a partless boss, and the driver asserts that inertness byte-identically instead of assuming it.
